StashItemId.description: A stash item's id: 16 random bytes the server picks, in unpadded base64url.

StashKind.description: What was shared. A link, text or prompt arrives as JSON; an image, video or file as its bytes. A prompt is a composer's whole prompt: its text and the files attached to it.

StashTaken.description: Which items a list holds: those not used yet, those used, or both.

StashListCursor.description: Where the next page of a list starts. Opaque to apps.

StashNote.description: What the person wrote beside the item when they shared it.

StashPreview.description: What a link's page says about itself, read by the server from its meta tags after the link was stashed.

site.description: The site's name, or its host name when the page names none.

iconUrl.description: The site's icon, as the page names it.

StashLink.description: A link written in a text's or prompt's words, exactly as it is written there, with what its page says about itself.

preview.description: Null until the server has read the page, or when it could not.

StashTarget.description: Where the person sent the item from the share sheet: a chat on a host (chatId), or a new chat in a project on it (projectPath with newChat true). That host puts it in the chat's draft and marks it taken.

StashItem.description: Something the person shared into Sikemux, kept on their account until they use it.

attachments.description: Only on prompts: the files attached to the prompt, oldest first. They are not listed on their own, get no events of their own, and are taken and deleted with their prompt.

links.description: Only on text and prompts: the links written in its words, in the order they first appear, without repeats.

name.description: The file's name. Only on items with a file.

mime.description: The file's media type. Only on items with a file.

size.description: The file's size in bytes. Only on items with a file.

preview.description: Only links get one, and only once the server has read the page; null until then, or when it could not. The links in a text's or prompt's words have theirs in links.

takenAt.description: When the item was attached to a prompt or delivered to its target; null until then. Taken items are deleted 30 days later.

fromDevice.description: The device that stashed the item, or null when the web app did.

StashList.description: A page of the stash, newest first.

cursor.description: Send as cursor for the next page. Absent on the last page.

seenAt.description: When the person last looked at the stash on any device; items created after it are new. Null until they first do.

StashAdd.description: A link, text or prompt to stash. A file is sent as its bytes instead, with Content-Type, X-Stash-Name (URI-encoded), and optionally X-Stash-Note and X-Stash-Target (URI-encoded JSON of a StashTarget), or X-Stash-Prompt with a prompt's id to attach it to that prompt. A file signed with SikemuxHost or SikemuxDevice also sends X-Body-Sha256, the body's SHA-256 in lowercase hex, which the signature covers in place of hashing the body.

StashAddPrompt.description: A composer's whole prompt to stash: its text, with its files uploaded after it.

attachmentCount.description: How many files will follow, each uploaded with X-Stash-Prompt set to the prompt's id. Until the last arrives the prompt is in no list and announced to no device; one left unfinished for a day is deleted.

StashSeen.description: When the person last looked at the stash. Setting it only ever moves it forward, and never past the server's clock.

StashUpdate.description: A change to an item: a new note, or taken true once it is used. A taken item cannot be untaken.
